# Observable Property

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ObservableProperty`](gmeow-ObservableProperty.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ObservableProperty>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory`](../../slices/sensory.md)

A physical, chemical, biological, or environmental property that can be observed or measured by a sensor. A value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses) so any new property — from temperature to neural activation to social sentiment — is a new individual, not a new class ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ObservableProperty`](gmeow-ObservableProperty.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
